assets: server/ — docs build pipeline and dev server
attackerControlledInputs: custom element attributes and props parsed by component factories in consuming apps
HTTP request paths and query strings handled by server/serve.ts in local development
CLI arguments of developer scripts in scripts/ (trusted developer input)
trustBoundaries: attribute/property values entering parsers and signals
HTTP requests reaching the local dev server
URLs fetched by example components (browser-enforced same-origin)
securityInvariants: setAttribute blocks on* handlers and enforces a URL protocol allowlist
production library code never spawns processes or evaluates strings
docs/ is generated output and excluded from audit; its sources are audited instead
